Context: 5. Advance Increments

6. In respect of the Stenographers, who become eligible for grant of these advance increments consequent upon the implementation of CCS (RP) Rules, 2016, they may be granted one/ two advance increments (as the case may be) in the vertical level, in which the Government servant is placed on the date of passing the test.
7. Benefit of these advance increments will not be treated as an anomaly for the purpose of stepping-up of pay of seniors.  
- GIO (6), FR 27.
